import numpy as np
exec(open('anal.py').read())
def r2(a,b): return 1-((a-b)**2).sum()/((b-b.mean(0))**2).sum()
for pd in ['pass_12','pass_17']:
    print(pd); full_report(pd,6,lams=(300,))
    lge=np.load(f'{pd}/logits.npy'); d=lge-lgb; bpp=lgb.argmax(1)
    pert=np.array([np.max(np.abs(d[i,[j for j in range(4) if j!=bpp[i]]]-d[i,bpp[i]])) for i in range(1000)])
    print('  pert median',np.median(pert).round(3),'p90',np.percentile(pert,90).round(3), ' L6 cls R2', round(r2(np.load(f'{pd}/cls_hidden_L6.npy'),np.load('pass_1/cls_hidden_L6.npy')),4),
          ' L5 mean R2', round(r2(np.load(f'{pd}/mean_hidden_L5.npy'),np.load('pass_1/mean_hidden_L5.npy')),4))
    p=lge.argmax(1)
    from collections import Counter
    print('  flips (base->new):',Counter([(int(bpp[i]),int(p[i])) for i in range(1000) if p[i]!=bpp[i]]))
